$comment: Exemptions from the stories guard (tests/unit/stories.test.ts), each with its reason. noControls: a component's stories file whose Default has nothing to control, so Controls stay off there too. afterHydration: a Default arg whose effect shows only once the story has hydrated, so its server HTML can't change. A row must name a stories file that exists, and an arg its Default lists.

noControls.src/components/ClickAwayListener/ClickAw: Its props say which presses count (mouseEvent, touchEvent) and what one does (onClickAway), and none changes what it renders; the Actions panel logs each press outside instead.
noControls.src/components/CssBaseline/CssBaseline.s: Its only prop is children: the resets apply to whatever it wraps.
noControls.src/components/NoSsr/NoSsr.stories.tsx: Nothing a reader can change shows: the server HTML always holds the fallback, and once mounted the children always replace it, a frame later with defer. Its other props are nodes.
noControls.src/components/useMediaQuery/useMediaQue: A hook, not a component: its Default shows what it returns at the current viewport.

src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.stories.t.title: The tooltip renders through Base UI's portal, which renders nothing on the server (as the reference's left it out), so its title shows only after hydration; with describeChild true the child doesn't carry it either.
src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.stories.t.placement: Base UI places the tooltip, which its portal renders only after hydration, so where it sits can't show in the server HTML.
src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.stories.t.arrow: The arrow is part of the tooltip, which Base UI's portal renders only after hydration.
